unsupportedReason: Unsupported on the frozen local Stack: approval.separate needs a native requester identity and retained proposal/version/audit binding; tenant.denied needs independently authenticated owner and outsider positive/negative controls; custody.bootstrap-revoked and custody.worker-replaced need original bootstrap retirement and isolated worker evidence. Stack supplies only controller and optional approver credentials. StudioPublicationObserver, StudioTenantObserver and StudioCustodyObserver require native identity/custody inputs absent from this local contract. A public HTTP response alone cannot establish these assertions.

provenance.derivation: Town oracle fixtures contain no native governance, credential custody, issued-key history or clarification event identities. Null marks an unavailable expectation and must fail oracle.verify; it is never a passing baseline.
